ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in high-contrast patches at the distal-lateral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation blob located at the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; smaller, less defined white patch at the distal tip of the left lobe; central fluke and peduncle regions are solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with a sharp interior vertex and approximately 40-degree separation angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased pixel-amplitude variance and jagged peaks at the lateral tips due to encrustations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the main trailing edge, terminating in a sharp upward sweep at the distal-lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; right tip cluster is larger and more pronounced.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the fluke tips; brownish filamentous material (biological debris or macroalgae) attached to and trailing from the distal edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetric pigmentation where the white mottling on the right lobe significantly exceeds the pigmentation area on the left lobe.
